text:
You need someone to implement server-side rendering in your React app with a simple integration.

Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I can help you add SSR to your React application in a clean, minimal way that fits your current setup without overcomplicating the codebase.

Since you mentioned that the integration should be simple, my approach would be to first review how your app is currently structured, then identify the most practical SSR path based on your existing React setup. If your project is already close to a framework or structure that supports SSR well, I can adapt it with as little disruption as possible. If there are rendering or routing considerations, I’ll make sure those are handled in a way that keeps the app stable and easy to maintain.

My focus would be on making the implementation straightforward, readable, and aligned with your current front-end code. I’m comfortable working with React and JavaScript, and I can also handle any supporting updates needed around routing, data fetching, or styling so the SSR setup works properly end to end.

I understand this is a small-budget job, so I’d keep the work focused on the core SSR implementation and avoid unnecessary extras. I communicate clearly, move efficiently, and aim to deliver something that works reliably rather than adding complexity you don’t need.

If you’d like, I can get started by reviewing your current app structure and outlining the simplest SSR approach for it. What framework or setup is your React app currently using?
